title: Nie każda myśl to rozkaz
sunoPrompt: Fast bass-heavy alternative metal groove, 142 BPM, tight syncopated low guitar riffs, punchy acoustic drums, controlled gritty melodic vocals. Repetitive clipped chorus, physical tension and decisive stop-start breaks; vocals remain sung. Clear natural Polish diction. Build most of the song around the repeated chorus.
negativeStyle: disco, disco polo, eurodance, dance-pop, four-on-the-floor kick, schlager, synth-pop, tropical pop, glossy pop production, corporate anthem, power ballad, autotuned vocals
